edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the sender of the internal transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
_tokenTransfer uses msg.sender-derived sender to gate trading and bot wallets.
unlock authorization compares _previousOwner against msg.sender.
lock computes _lockTime from block.timestamp permitting timestamp manipulation.
unlock requires block.timestamp to exceed _lockTime.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
_transfer conditionally invokes swapAndLiquify when the token threshold is exceeded.
_transfer delegates the actual accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard when neither party is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferToExcluded when only the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferFromExcluded when only the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferBothExcluded when both parties are excluded.
swapAndLiquify writes the marketing wallet address used for the ETH payout.
_tokenTransfer reads canTrade to restrict transfers to the owner before trading is enabled.
_tokenTransfer reads botWallets to block blacklisted addresses from trading.
External ETH transfer to marketingWallet hands control to an untrusted address while swapAndLiquify state is still being updated.
Uniswap router swap performs an external call that can re-enter before balances are settled.
Uniswap router addLiquidityETH performs an external call with ETH value that can re-enter.
Arbitrary ERC20 transfer invokes external token code that can re-enter claimOtherTokens.
ETH transfer to an arbitrary payable address can re-enter clearStuckBalance.
ETH transfer to marketingWallet can re-enter claimTokens before completion.
time parameter flows into _lockTime in lock affecting ownership lock duration.
amount parameter flows into internal _transfer as the transfer quantity.
contractTokenBalance local flows into swapAndLiquify as the swap amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The time parameter exists only to compute the owner lock timestamp inside lock and should be folded into that core function node.
The amount parameter is a transient transfer quantity consumed by the transfer path and should merge into the core transfer function.
The contractTokenBalance local is only used to decide and size the swap-and-liquify call and should merge into that core function node.
